learning_objective: 🚽 Discover how the body filters out toxic wastes through the incredible micro-machines called nephrons in our kidneys!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: अमोनिया उत्सर्जक (अत्यधिक विषैली अमोनिया का उत्सर्जन करने वाले जीव, जैसे मछलियां)
नेफ्रॉन / वृक्काणु (किडनी की संरचनात्मक और कार्यात्मक सूक्ष्म इकाई)
कोशिकागुच्छ (नेफ्रॉन में रक्त केशिकाओं का गुच्छा जो खून छानता है)
हीमोडायलिसिस / अपोहन (कृत्रिम किडनी द्वारा रक्त को साफ करने की प्रक्रिया)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Animals excrete wastes based on water availability. Ammonia is highly toxic and needs lots of water (fish). Urea is less toxic and needs moderate water (humans, frogs). Uric acid is the least toxic and needs almost no water, excreted as paste (birds, reptiles).
Consists of a pair of kidneys (bean-shaped), a pair of ureters (tubes), a urinary bladder (storage), and a urethra (exit tube). Kidneys are the main filters that remove urea from the blood.

Each kidney has nearly one million nephrons. A nephron consists of a filtering unit (Glomerulus + Bowman's capsule) and a highly coiled tubule (PCT, Loop of Henle, DCT) that leads to a collecting duct.

Involves three steps: 1. Glomerular Filtration (blood is filtered under high pressure), 2. Reabsorption (the body takes back 99% of the useful water, glucose, and salts from the filtrate), 3. Secretion (extra wastes like H+ and K+ are actively pushed into the urine).

The brain and hormones control urine concentration. If your body lacks water, the hypothalamus releases ADH (Antidiuretic Hormone), which tells the kidneys to reabsorb more water, preventing dehydration.

fun_activity.title: 🟡 Why is Urine Yellow?
fun_activity.instructions: The yellow color of urine comes from a chemical called 'Urochrome'. Urochrome is a waste product generated when your body breaks down old, dead red blood cells! If you drink lots of water, the urochrome is diluted (clear urine), but if you are dehydrated, it becomes highly concentrated (dark yellow).

exam_tips: 📌 The Descending limb of the Loop of Henle is permeable to water but almost impermeable to electrolytes. The Ascending limb is exactly the opposite (impermeable to water, allows electrolytes out).
📌 Explain the RAAS (Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone System) mechanism—it regulates blood pressure and fluid balance by causing sodium and water reabsorption.
📌 Malpighian tubules are the excretory organs of insects (like cockroaches), while Flame cells do this job in flatworms (Platyhelminthes).
quick_recap: ⭐ The presence of glucose (Glycosuria) and ketone bodies (Ketonuria) in urine are strong indicators of Diabetes Mellitus.
⭐ An adult human excretes, on average, 1 to 1.5 liters of urine per day.
⭐ The JGA (Juxtaglomerular apparatus) is a sensitive region that regulates the Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR).
